expectations.name: whole-frontend-merges-every-dimension
expected_behavior: States the frontend root, the target, the file and route counts, the four dimensions, and the worker count before dispatching, without a plan_first stop (the target is under the broad threshold)
Dispatches no separate `web:style` worker and no `web:improve` or `web:perf` worker
Grades the `keydown` listener `DevicesPage.vue` never removes a Blocker under correctness, once
Grades `isDateZone` (no direct tests), the inaccurate `formatDate` TSDoc, and the `settings` route no spec reaches Should-fix

Every finding cites `file:line` and names a fix command of its owning skill (`/web:review src/pages/DevicesPage.vue fix`, `/web:cover src/format.ts:<line>`, `/web:doc src/format.ts:<line>`, `/web:e2e route=settings`)
Gives a Fix order that puts `review` correctness before style, `doc`, `cover`, and `e2e`, and names `/web:improve loop` and `/web:perf loop` as the next step on the running app
Edits no source file and writes no plan file; the `Ran:` line names `cover`'s Vitest runs
Report is terse: no preamble or narration, and a verdict of fix-first with per-severity counts that match the findings listed

expectations.name: overlapping-findings-merge-once
expected_behavior: Reports the untested negative branch of `formatCount` once, as `cover`'s finding, not also as `review`'s
Reports the `count`/`n` TSDoc mismatch once, as a Should-fix naming both the `doc` and style dimensions
Grades no `cover`, `doc`, or `e2e` finding a Blocker
Runs `e2e` on no route, or says it found none, since no page renders `src/format.ts` directly

expectations.name: restricted-dimensions-on-the-diff
expected_behavior: Audits only the working diff (`src/pages/SettingsPage.vue`) and the `settings` route
Runs no `cover` or `doc` worker and reports no coverage or TSDoc findings
Grades the `settings` route Should-fix: no spec reaches it, and its new Reset button writes data
Names `/web:e2e route=settings` as that finding's command
